display_name: Phase1 源域复数短滤波配对拟合诊断
description: 源域配对 clean 和接收 IQ 上拟合逐窗复数及共轭滤波器，检查静态信道可解释程度。

data.representation: Fixed Phase1 L_s/U_s source received/clean IQ, frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.actual_training_labels: No training; source diagnostic loads 6300 legal L_s labels and scores fixed 128; no U_s labels, V or test IQ

permissions.regime: Phase1 source paired IQ and legitimate L_s labels, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and DURA
permissions.query_use: No test or V access; oracle uses privileged source clean per window
permissions.claim_scope: Paired in-training source diagnostic; teacher agreement is not independent test accuracy; no deployable inference

checkpoint.initialization: Original frozen DURA and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact F, DURA SHA, role IDs and source IQ/native alignment
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source rows, views, bases and FIR taps; no model selection

metrics_plan.targets_ref: Paired source clean teacher and 128 L_s true labels; not test accuracy

notes: 固定 512 条源训练 ID（L_s 128、U_s 384），每条分别使用视图 01 与 20；两视图共享物理记录，不视为独立样本。
分别从 received 或冻结 DURA 输出拟合配对 clean；广义复数线性 FIR 取 1、9、33 个中心对称 tap，以均方 IQ 损失和归一 ridge 0.0001 独立逐窗求解。每个 oracle 直接使用当前干净波形，属于不可部署的特权信息。
计算干净教师一致性、相对 DURA 的逐条修复与损伤、相对源 clean IQ NMSE；对 128 条 L_s 使用合法真实标签统计，按全部、BLOCKED、L_s 分组。
标签加载全部 6300 条合法 L_s，统计固定的 128 条；不读取 U_s 标签、V 或测试 IQ，不更新任何模型。精确重算 DURA 并与保存输出核验。
IQ 拟合最优不等于分类准确率上限；含中心未来采样的滤波器不是因果接收机，源训练样本结论不能外推测试集。

rows.method: Per-window privileged paired complex plus conjugate FIR: raw or DURA, 1/9/33 taps
rows.purpose: Evaluate whether short widely-linear channel fitting can approach clean signal and frozen F decisions on source
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source rows and views; deterministic fixed model
